title: Network Documentation: The Complete Beginner's Guide

scenes.narration: Your best engineer leaves the company. And everything about the network was in their head. Good documentation is the cure.

scenes.heading: Blueprints for engineers
scenes.narration: Networks need two kinds of drawings. A physical diagram shows cables, ports and where things sit. A logical diagram shows addresses, V L A Ns and routing. A baseline records what normal looks like. Every change needs a rollback plan written down.

scenes.heading: Common mix-ups
scenes.narration: Three tips. You need both kinds. Keep it up to date all the time. Take a baseline while things are healthy.

scenes.heading: Remember this
scenes.narration: So, to recap. Keep a physical and a logical diagram. Take a baseline when things are healthy. Always write a rollback plan. Ready to practise? Try the Courseiva documentation lab.
